benefits.title: Why restore your headlights instead of replacing them
benefits.subtitle: Cloudy, yellow headlights cut your visibility, lower your car's value and can fail inspection. Restoration fixes all of it for a fraction of the cost of new units.

items.title: Up to 70% more light
items.description: Clear plastic lets through far more light than oxidised lenses. You see better in the dark and fog — and meet oncoming traffic more safely.

items.title: Passes inspection
items.description: Heavily yellowed or cracked lenses are a common failure. We restore the light output so your car passes the inspection.

items.title: Save thousands
items.description: New headlights often cost 5,000–20,000 SEK each fitted. Restoration delivers the same clarity from 799 SEK for the whole car.

items.title: Higher resale value
items.description: Clear, fresh headlights make the whole car look newer and lift its value before a sale or trade-in.

process.title: How headlight restoration works
process.subtitle: Six steps from dull, yellow plastic to a factory-clear finish. Every headlight is sanded, polished and sealed by hand with professional materials.

steps.title: Masking & prep
steps.description: We clean and mask the paint around the headlight so sanding never touches surrounding parts.
steps.alt: Masking paint around a headlight before sanding

steps.title: Wet sanding
steps.description: Oxidised, yellow plastic is removed in stages with progressively finer paper, from coarse P400 up to P3000.
steps.alt: Wet sanding an oxidised headlight with sandpaper

steps.title: Machine polishing
steps.description: Fine polishing with a rotary machine and compound restores depth, clarity and gloss to the plastic.
steps.alt: Machine polishing a headlight to a crystal clear finish

steps.title: UV protection
steps.description: A professional UV sealant locks in the surface and shields it from the sun's UV rays so the gloss lasts for years.
steps.alt: Applying UV protection to a freshly polished headlight

steps.title: Quality check
steps.description: We check the light pattern, evenness and finish in daylight and against a light source before handover.
steps.alt: Quality checking the light output of a restored headlight

steps.title: Ready to drive
steps.description: You get the car back with headlights that shine like new — ready for the road and inspection right away.
steps.alt: Car with crystal clear headlights ready for delivery

faq.title: Headlight restoration FAQ
faq.subtitle: Answers to what car owners in Stockholm ask most about headlight polishing and restoration.

items.question: How long does headlight restoration last?
items.answer: With our professional UV protection the result normally lasts 2–3 years or more, depending on how much sun the car gets. Without UV protection the plastic starts to yellow again within months, which is why the sealant is always included.

items.question: Will the car pass inspection after restoration?
items.answer: Yes. Heavily yellowed, cloudy or cracked headlights are a common inspection failure because they reduce light output. We restore the clarity so the light meets requirements — in the vast majority of cases restoration is enough to pass.

items.question: How much does it cost to restore headlights?
items.answer: Restoring both headlights on a car costs from 799 SEK including UV protection. Motorcycles and mopeds from 499 SEK. For businesses and fleets we provide a quote. You always get a fixed price before we start.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: A typical car takes about 45–60 minutes. You can usually wait while we work, or leave the car while you do something else.

items.question: Can all headlights be restored?
items.answer: Most modern headlights are made of polycarbonate plastic and restore beautifully. If the lens is cracked or damaged on the inside, polishing can't help — we'll tell you straight away and won't charge you needlessly.

items.question: Do I drop the car off or do you come to me?
items.answer: We're a mobile service and come to you across Greater Stockholm — at home, at work or in the garage. We just need space to work and access to power.

items.question: What's the difference versus replacing the headlights?
items.answer: New headlights often cost several thousand SEK each plus fitting. Restoration delivers the same clear plastic and light pattern from 799 SEK for the whole car, and takes an hour instead of days waiting for parts.
